title: Don’t Go To Bed — gameplay trailer
description: Watch the official trailer for Don’t Go To Bed, a family building and exploration adventure for Android, iPhone and iPad.
note: English gameplay trailer with family narration and local multiplayer. A German-language trailer is also available on the product page.
context: Play solo or with family on the same trusted Wi-Fi. Explore, build routes and find Mammy before nightfall. All characters and gameplay are free, with optional support tips.

title: Watchful — personal AI watchers trailer
description: Watch the official Watchful trailer, showing a personal AI watcher, a manual web search, source links and a notification.
note: Recorded in an iOS simulator with a simulated Berlin location. The trailer demonstrates a manual check, not scheduled background execution or a completed purchase. Current plans and features are described on the app page.
context: Create a watcher for public information such as prices or releases. Define the conditions that matter and check the linked sources before acting. Background timing depends on your phone and its settings.

title: StarJar — chore and reward app trailer
description: Watch the StarJar trailer and explore the chore and reward app for families on Android and iOS.
note: This trailer introduces StarJar. See the product page for current screenshots, features and free or Premium options.
context: Parents set tasks and review completed chores. Children earn stars and save for rewards the family chooses together. Read-aloud support helps children who are not yet reading.

title: Elchem — gameplay trailer
description: Watch Elchem’s gameplay trailer: a map-based adventure with elements, recipes, equipment and encounters.
note: An earlier gameplay preview, published in March 2024. Elchem is in development; the video is not a promise of the current release’s features.
context: Elchem connects a real-world map with a game world of elements and encounters. Explore the project’s gameplay page for its world, creatures and equipment.
